slides.texte_overlay:
7 skills that'll make you
dangerously capable in
your 20s
Learn basic first aid. CPR, how to stop bleeding, what to do when someone faints. One weekend course, and you're the guy who knows what to do in an emergency.
Learn to write a clear email. Short subject, one request, a deadline. Clear writing gets you answers faster and makes you look sharp at any job.
Learn to read a contract before you sign it. Rent, phone plans, job offers. Ten careful minutes can save you months of regret and a lot of money.
Learn to plan a trip from start to finish. Routes, budget, bookings, backup plans. Organising travel trains the same skills as running a project.
Learn something new every day. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and it's made me the guy with an answer, or a story, for everything.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. It's made me the guy with an answer, or a story, for everything.

slides.texte_overlay: Learn to swim properly. Not just splashing, real strokes and real distance. It's a lifelong skill for fitness, holidays by the sea and the safety of the people around you.
Learn to say no without guilt. "I can't this time, thanks for asking." Protecting your time is what lets you say a real yes to what matters.
